title: Lift the Facts, Write It Yourself

slides.prompt: Monday we chose whole sentences. What do we lift today?
slides.hint: Short facts, three words or fewer.
slides.notes: 60-min Thu lesson, sl_h3. Outcomes (teacher-kept): complete 8 table fields with source-lifted answers; draft the p.70 paragraph with linkers and 3 phrases.

slides.feedback: Two words win. The table wants three or fewer.
slides.notes: Rule-first error analysis. Vote A or B, then ask where B came from in the passage. Fallback: fingers or mini-boards.

slides.prompt: What are the first three steps?
slides.text: Washing our hands properly is one of the best ways to stay healthy. It helps prevent the spread of germs. First, wet your hands with clean, running water. Next, apply enough soap to cover all hand surfaces. Then, rub your hands together for at least 20 seconds. Wash the backs of your hands, between your fingers and under your nails.
slides.notes: Teacher-requested excerpt of the Module p.70 suggested answer, shortened. Expected: wet, soap, rub. No answer bolding.

slides.prompt: How do we finish, and why does it matter?
slides.text: Finally, rinse your hands well under clean water and dry them with a tissue or an air dryer. By washing our hands properly, we can protect ourselves and others from getting sick.
slides.hint: Two waters and two dryers appear. The label decides.
slides.notes: Competing-information warning lives here and pays off in fields 22-23.

slides.feedback: Chunk 1 names running water for wetting.
slides.notes: Click fills the blank inline; Reset clears it. Matches worksheet key.

slides.feedback: Cover needs a place. Enough tells amount.
Four words break the rule. Lift two.
slides.notes: Reinforces the rule slide. Matches worksheet key.

slides.feedback: Nails belong to field 21. Read the label.
Fingers were field 20. The label decides.
Running water was for wetting. Rinse takes clean water.
One dryer only. The key accepts tissue or air dryer.
Four words break the rule. Lift two.

slides.answer: prevent the spread, follow simple steps, apply soap, cover all surfaces, rub together, rinse well, stay healthy, protect ourselves.
slides.feedback: Circle 3 on paper. Steal phrases, not sentences.
slides.hint: Linkers to glue them: first, next, then, finally.
slides.notes: Migration trade-off: the legacy tap-counter bank has no v1 preset, so paper circling plus oral shortlist replaces it. Pupils still choose any 3 of 8.
